title: polite-crawler capture record
description: One line of the capture log of polite-crawler (captures/<source>/<year>/<month>.ndjson): a record of one fetch decision, the payload of schema 2. A reader ignores the fields that it does not know.

id.description: The source, a dot, and the first 12 hexadecimal digits of content_hash. A citation names this id.

source.description: The crawler writes fetch. An application can add its own sources.

kind.description: capture, revisit (a 304) or skipped for the source fetch; override for a held-back read that a person allowed.

external_id.description: The URL of the record, with its secrets as REDACTED.

content_hash.description: The SHA-256 of the sorted JSON of source, kind, external_id and payload. Times, scope and labels are not part of it.

scope.description: A label of the application. The crawler does not read it.

labels.description: Labels of the application, for example the lineage of a request. The crawler does not read them.

payload.description: The fields of the record. Their shape depends on source and kind.

fetch.description: A fetch decision: a response (capture, revisit) or a request that the crawler did not send (skipped).

url.description: The requested URL, with its secrets as REDACTED.

recipe.description: The recipe of the request: page, robots.txt, sitemap, feed, archive-copy (a copy from a web archive), archive-index (an index of a web archive), or a recipe of an application.

rendered.description: True when the headless browser made the capture.

status.description: The HTTP status, or 0 when no response came.

outcome.description: ok, not-modified, redirect, error, not-html, blocked, challenge, rate-limited, unavailable, gone and others.

blob.description: The SHA-256 of the stored body.

validators.description: The validators that a conditional request sent. The validator memo of the host can leave out if-none-match.

revisit_of.description: The capture whose body a 304 confirmed.

robots.description: allowed for a page that robots.txt permits; not-checked for an api request.

truncated.description: True when the body is only the first part of the response.

cut.description: True when the server cut a compressed body. It is not a copy to keep.

unasked.description: True when an API answered with a web page that the request did not accept. It is not a copy to keep.

location.description: The target of a redirect, with its secrets as REDACTED.

final_url.description: The URL that a render ended on.

range.description: The byte range of a range request. The body is a part of the resource, not its stored copy.

signed.description: The request had a Web Bot Auth signature: the key id (a JWK thumbprint) and the URL of the key directory. The record holds no key.

subrequests.description: The requests of a rendered page that the crawler allowed and refused.

robotsCheck.description: Why robots.txt permitted or refused the request: the robots.txt capture, the product tokens and the rule.

signals.description: The usage signals of the response: content signals, AIPREF, X-Robots-Tag, RSL and TDMRep.

override.description: A person gave the URL of a held-back document, and the hold stopped for one read or verification.
